'''Starshipwrights and Aerospace Engineers Incorporated''' was a company that specialized in producing customized [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] upgrades and [[Starship/Legends|starship]] modifications. The company began as a small affair, but through a franchising system, the business grew to a megacorporation inside three hundred [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. They were a [[voting sponsor]] to the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]], having invested in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] in the years following the establishment of the [[Corporate Sector Charter]].<ref name="HSCS" /> The company produced the [[Sun Skipper 2000 Sun Jammer]].<ref name="GFT" />
